bioEn:
Guillaume is a French cinematographer. His beginnings as an operator on business card films for large CAC 40 groups, (Vinci, Alstom, GDFSuez, EDF, Societe Generale, L'Oreal, etc.), taught him how to work effectively, to have a flexible approach and to be able to handle different situations. 
He is capable to work on very different kind of films such as fashion/comedy (Kenzo, Longhcamp...), automobile (Citroën, Mini, DS...) or luxury (Dior, Givenchy, Lancôme, L'Oréal...). 
Guillaume always put his sensitivity and technical knowledge at the service of the director.
